query: What minimal set of simulator cases and augmentation parameter ranges (attenuation, scatter, transducer misalignment, noise) are required to validate simulator-to-real transfer?

response.query: What minimal set of simulator cases and augmentation parameter ranges (attenuation, scatter, transducer misalignment, noise) are required to validate simulator-to-real transfer?
response.answer: Minimal set: attenuation, scatter, noise. Essential ranges: 10-50% attenuation, 1-5% scatter, 0.1-1.0 dB noise.
